newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends mixed, aided by late bean strength.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends mixed, aided by late bean strength.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures ended mixed, with nearby March buoyed by a late rally in CBOT soybeans, traders said.
Beans rallied back from their lows as Cargill bought two million bushels of March soybeans at the close, traders said.
"We said all along today that if you couldn't keep beans down, wheat would come back," a KCBT trader said shortly before the close.
KCBT wheat dropped to its daily lows early on news that Egypt bought wheat from France and India bought from Australia.
KCBT wheat closed three cents per bushel lower to 1-3/4 cent higher, with March up 1-3/4 at $4.05. March had been as low as $4.00 earlier.
Volumes were extremely slack throughout the session. Commodity broker E D & F Man International was a featured seller during the session, selling 1.2 million March and 1.3 million July bushels.
